scenes.title: THE THREE LAWS
scenes.weather: NO wind, NO rain, NO birds
scenes.objective: Arjun teaches Kira enough control to survive; Kira wants to know what he is.

shots.move: STATIC — tripod. The camera stops hiding
shots.action: Ninety kilometres of bleached, cracked white salt; ghost-foundations of vanished buildings as low rectangles; a half-melted transmission pylon leaning on the horizon; two tiny figures dead centre
shots.light: enormous flat white top-light, three stops brighter than any previous scene, no shadows, no direction
shots.vfx: CG salt plain extension; heat-free shimmer; pylon
shots.sound: THE SOUND FLOOR DROPS TO NEAR ZERO. Footsteps are too loud. No wind, no birds, no score

shots.action: Kira turns a full circle, appalled. 'Why is it so quiet—'
shots.light: flat white, skin looks bloodless
shots.sound: her voice has no reverb whatsoever — an acoustic wrongness

shots.action: Overhead: Kira paces the low rectangle of a vanished building — she is standing, unknowing, in the footprint of the Anjari market square where her mother died
shots.light: flat, shadowless — the overhead angle has nothing to model

shots.action: Arjun turns Kira's hands over: gold dendritic hairlines running knuckles to elbow, permanent now, dormant and matte
shots.light: flat white
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — dormant Tether filament: matte gold-bronze, no emission

shots.action: THE THREE LAWS. He sets her feet with his boot, squares her shoulders with his hands. Physical teaching, not speeches
shots.light: flat white; the two of them are the only vertical objects in 90km
shots.sound: the flats' dead air; every consonant unnaturally present

shots.action: 'The current takes payment in you. Always. Every time.' A long silence he doesn't fill
shots.light: flat white on a face that has nowhere to hide

shots.action: He ties the notebook shut with a RED BOOT-LACE and pockets it. Continuity marker for the rest of the film
shots.light: flat white

shots.action: She offers the stolen brass regulator. 'Keep it. I'm not diving this week.' She clips it to her belt — where it stays for the rest of the film
shots.light: flat white
shots.sound: a small brass click; one warm note of score enters the void

shots.move: alternating locked wides and intimate handheld CUs
shots.action: TRAINING: anchoring to the pylon; snapping tethers and burning her palms; braiding two lines and lifting a bleached bus shell 15cm; the palms bleeding; trying again
shots.light: flat white throughout — deliberately monotonous, so the montage is about her, not the light
shots.vfx: tether sim across all beats; rope-burn prosthetics
shots.sound: the singing tether tone; snap; her frustration

shots.action: Kira runs fifty metres and swings out over the salt on a single gold line, LAUGHING — the first laugh in the film
shots.light: flat white; the gold tether is the only saturated colour in 90km of frame
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — single load-bearing tether with visible catenary sag and elastic recoil
shots.sound: her laugh; the tether singing; the score's first major-key phrase

shots.action: Arjun watching her, and the watching costs him something
shots.light: flat white

shots.action: Night. A driftwood fire on white salt — the only fire in a landscape with nothing to burn. Meera awake and grey-faced delivers the fourth law
shots.light: firelight is the ONLY source; the flats go black beyond 6m
shots.sound: fire; still no wind, which makes the fire sound wrong — it burns straight up

scenes.title: SKIFF SIX
scenes.objective: Riya wants to bring him in; Arjun wants twelve hours; both lie about what they want.

shots.action: Skiff #6 sits alone on 90km of white salt, cracked left fan cowling, engine ticking as it cools; Riya walks twenty metres out with hands visible and empty
shots.light: flat white; the skiff's grey is the darkest object in frame
shots.sound: cooling metal ticks — enormous in the dead air

shots.action: Twenty metres of white salt between them for the whole scene. They never close the distance
shots.light: flat white

shots.action: 'Don't do the thing where you say my name like you're checking it against a list.'
shots.light: flat white
shots.sound: silence after the line, held four seconds

shots.action: The anchor-stone tossed and caught in Riya's gloved palm; it pulses amber and she FLINCHES — she's seen these on bodies
shots.light: flat white with the amber pulse as the only colour

shots.move: very slow push (the only camera move on the flats)
shots.action: 'I'm asking you to show me ninety seconds I don't have. Riya. I don't know what I did.'
shots.light: flat white
shots.sound: we hear her glove tighten on the stone

shots.action: She goes procedural to survive it: '03:40. Archive shift change is eleven minutes. Get the girl a coat, you look like kidnappers.'
shots.light: flat white

shots.action: She stops without turning: 'The noodle stall woman calls you Vikram. I paid her to keep the tab open. Eight years, Arjun.'
shots.light: flat white

shots.action: Skiff #6 lifts and goes, dragging a salt-dust wake across an otherwise perfectly still white plain
shots.light: flat white
shots.vfx: CG skiff, dust wake that hangs and does not disperse (no wind)
shots.sound: fans, receding, then absolute silence resuming like water closing

scenes.title: FOUR FRAMES
scenes.slug: EXT. SALT FLATS — NIGHT / INT. CRADLE CORE 2057
scenes.objective: Arjun wants sleep; the stone wants to show him something.

shots.action: Firelight on white salt. Arjun holds the anchor-stone in both hands like a man holding a bird
shots.light: firelight only, hard falloff to black

shots.action: FLASHBACK 2057: warm amber Cradle training hall. Cadet Arjun fails to hold a bastion; it shatters. Dev picks up the pieces of light and hands them back
shots.light: warm amber tungsten — the warmest lighting in the entire film
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — a shattered bastion as physical shards of light that can be picked up like glass
shots.sound: a shattering chime; laughter; the room has generous reverb, unlike the flats

shots.action: 'Nobody holds a corner. You hold the anchor and let the corner argue.' He taps the boy's sternum twice
shots.light: warm amber key
shots.sound: two soft taps, mixed forward — a motif that returns in Sc.30

shots.action: BACK TO PRESENT: Arjun's eyes wet in firelight
shots.light: firelight

shots.action: FOUR FRAMES: a brass lever with a red grip / a hand / not Dev's hand / HIS hand
shots.light: blown amber-white

shots.action: He drops the stone like it's hot; it lands in the salt still pulsing
shots.light: firelight + amber pulse from the ground
shots.sound: his breathing out of control for the first time

shots.action: He writes: ASK: WHO PULLED THE RING? Then draws a BOX around it so he can't tear it out
shots.light: firelight only, flickering on wet paper

scenes.title: ARCHIVE B7
scenes.slug: INT. BASTION SPIRE — ARCHIVE LEVEL B7
scenes.objective: Get INQ-0803-59 out of a sealed cold-room in eleven minutes.

shots.angle: eye, deep one-point perspective down the racks
shots.action: Amber emergency lighting; hundreds of grey evidence drums on frosted racks; breath fogging; three figures entering a corridor of the dead
shots.light: amber emergency only, hard pools every 8m, black between
shots.sound: refrigeration hum; the loudest room tone in the film

shots.action: Riya — hair now in a SINGLE BRAID, first appearance of the braid — swipes a supervisor's card. 'Eleven minutes. Rack forty-one. Nothing with a red band; those are the Anjari remains.'
shots.light: amber, card reader green

shots.action: Kira in a too-big Authority coat reading drum labels with her mouth slightly open. 'There's a drum here with my mother's district on it.'
shots.light: amber pools passing across her face rhythmically

shots.action: Stencil on grey steel: INQ-0803-59 · SEALED · MINISTERIAL
shots.light: one amber pool

shots.action: The drum cracked open: paper files, a Corps helmet with a shattered visor, a brass footage cartridge
shots.light: amber, and cold blue from inside the drum's frost

shots.action: He turns the helmet. On the inside of the brow, in grease pencil, in his own handwriting: VEDH, A. — CADET
shots.light: single amber source raking the interior

shots.action: 'Why is my helmet in the inquiry.' Nobody answers
shots.light: amber, and the reflection of the shattered visor across his eyes
shots.sound: the refrigeration hum returning too loud

shots.action: Overhead PA chime; the racks' amber lights begin flicking one by one to red down the length of the room
shots.light: amber → red sweeping away from camera

scenes.title: NINETY SECONDS (MIDPOINT)
scenes.slug: INT. PLAYBACK BOOTH / INT. CRADLE CORE 2059
scenes.objective: Arjun wants to see the ninety seconds; every part of him also wants not to.

shots.angle: eye, four faces in a row
shots.action: A cramped brass playback booth; four faces lit only by a small 4:3 screen inside our 2.39 frame — the aspect ratio itself is a jail
shots.light: screen light only, flickering

shots.action: FRAME-FOR-FRAME MATCH: Dev pinned on the level-3 catwalk. Now degraded to helmet-cam quality: 4:3, 60% desaturated, scan lines, exposure pumping
shots.light: identical to 1D, then processed through the helmet-cam LUT
shots.vfx: helmet-cam degrade pass over the original Sc.1 plates — CONTINUITY CRITICAL

shots.action: 'Cadet. Go up.' Same performance, same frame, degraded
shots.light: identical

shots.move: identical run-in, then the camera KEEPS GOING
shots.action: THE CUT WE DIDN'T GET: Arjun's hand closes on the brass lever with the red grip and HAULS. The containment ring retracts. Dev is freed. For one second it works
shots.light: amber, white bloom rising
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — containment ring retraction; the geometry that kills 200,000 people, rendered as a piece of ordinary industrial machinery working correctly
shots.sound: hydraulics releasing — a satisfying, awful, mechanical success

shots.action: Dev pulls himself free, looks up at the boy with pride and horror: 'Oh, Arjun. What have you done.'
shots.light: white bloom now keying him
shots.sound: his voice tiny and tinny and clear

shots.action: The bloom comes up the shaft. Not fire. Silent, white, gentle. It takes the catwalks. It takes Dev
shots.light: the bloom is total; everything else is gone
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — the Bloom consuming a 200m shaft; matter does not burn, it goes WHITE and stops
shots.sound: the recording's audio CLIPS AND DIES, leaving only the 38Hz tone

shots.action: The last thing recorded: the boy's own reflection in his shattered visor, mouth open, lit white
shots.light: pure white

shots.action: Back in the booth. The little screen holds white, then black. NOBODY MOVES FOR ELEVEN SECONDS
shots.light: the white screen fading to black takes the only light out of the room with it

shots.action: He opens the notebook to the boxed sentence ASK: WHO PULLED THE RING? and writes beneath it, in pencil: You did.
shots.light: screen backwash only, very dim

shots.action: 'Two hundred thousand people, one hundred and thirty-eight Guardians, and my sister was in the Anjari market buying thread.' Perfectly level, which is worse
shots.light: a single amber rack light through the booth glass

shots.action: ANJARI MARKET, 14:12, 2059 — four seconds, silent: a girl of fifteen, long plait, school satchel, choosing thread at a stall. She looks up at a white light with mild curiosity
shots.light: warm real afternoon sun — colour floods in for four seconds
shots.vfx: period set extension; the bloom's first white edge

shots.action: He puts the helmet back in the drum, closes it, and squares it on the rack — neat, like a man tidying his own grave. 'Don't learn anything from this.'
shots.light: amber going red as the alarm state changes

scenes.title: THE STAIRWELL
scenes.objective: Escape; Meera wants to confess before she loses the nerve.

shots.action: Riya puts her Nullpin sidearm on the floor and slides it away — she will not shoot her own people. Then walks toward the corridor
shots.light: red alarm strobe

shots.angle: extreme high, straight down the stairwell shaft
shots.action: Vertigo shot down eleven flights of service stair; three figures spiralling down; red strobe on every landing
shots.light: red strobe at 1Hz, hard

shots.action: On a half-landing Meera grabs Arjun's wrist with the BRASS HAND and stops him dead
shots.light: red strobe
shots.sound: the grab; both of them stopping

shots.action: The warped, half-burnt 2058 Corps class photograph — she has been carrying it since the fire. Her finger on the fourth figure: AMARA OKONKWO
shots.light: red strobe making the photo readable only every other second

shots.action: Three steps above. The surname lands on her like a dropped weight. '...Say that name again.'
shots.light: red strobe on half her face
shots.sound: the klaxon suddenly seems far away

shots.action: THE CONFESSION: 'I pulled you out of the Anjari salt when you were five. She was still warm and you would not let go of her collar, and I broke two of your fingers getting you out, and I am sorry, and I would do it again.'
shots.light: red strobe — and for the four seconds of the confession's core, the strobe HOLDS ON, unbroken
shots.sound: score: a single sustained string cluster

shots.action: 'My father was a fisherman and he is DEAD—' / 'Your father is on the north coast, child, and he is building something with your name on the plans.'
shots.light: red strobe
shots.sound: boots above them; two seconds where nobody moves

shots.angle: low, from the bottom of the flight
shots.action: Kira turns and runs down alone. Arjun follows. The team is now three people who can't look at each other
shots.light: red strobe receding down the shaft

scenes.title: THE CONCORD (VILLAIN PARLEY)
scenes.objective: Dev wants Arjun to understand and to bring him Kira willingly.

shots.move: ABSOLUTELY STATIC — no camera movement anywhere in this scene
shots.action: SUNLIGHT. The Anjari coast as it was: market square, bicycles, mango sellers, laundry lines, a school wall painted with fish, gulls, a blue sea. Colour floods the film for the first time since Sc.1
shots.light: real, hard, hot 2pm tropical sunlight — the only natural sunlight in Acts I-II
shots.vfx: full CG period environment build; crowd; gulls; sea
shots.sound: a market, gulls, wind, children — and it is UNBEARABLY beautiful

shots.action: Dev sits on a low wall, barefoot, charcoal coat, broken gorget, wedding band on a chain, peeling an orange. CRYSTALLISATION STAGE 2: left jaw and neck translucent with slow light beneath
shots.light: hard sun from camera-left, deep warm bounce off the whitewashed wall
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — crystallisation: translucent crystalline tissue with sub-surface scattering and slow internal light drift, growing out of the collar line

shots.action: Arjun standing, wet from the rain of the real world — the only wet thing in a dry sunlit frame
shots.light: hard sun; his wetness steams faintly

shots.action: 'I experienced two hundred thousand deaths. On a loop. From the inside. For what I estimate was forty-one years of subjective time.' Delivered mildly, while eating fruit
shots.light: hard sun, deep shadow on the crystalline side

shots.action: He gestures — and every person in the market square TURNS TO FACE CAMERA at the same instant. Two hundred faces. Perfectly calm. Perfectly still
shots.light: unchanged, which makes it worse
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — 200 crowd actors turning on one frame, then absolute stillness including hair and cloth; only the gulls keep moving
shots.sound: the market noise CUTS OUT on the turn, leaving only gulls and wind

shots.action: The Concord explained. 'Eight million in the first pass. I sever one function. Not memory — just the grief channel.'
shots.light: hard sun

shots.action: 'You want to turn eight million people into the Anjari flats. Quiet. Clean. Nothing coming back.'
shots.light: hard sun
shots.sound: a two-second hole in the ambience

shots.action: THE MASK SLIPS ONE MILLIMETRE: 'I don't remember Amara's face. I took mine out first. I know I loved her. I have the fact. The rest is a hole shaped like a woman.' Then, looking at the orange: 'It doesn't hurt at all. It's marvellous.'
shots.light: hard sun; a gull shadow crosses his face once

shots.action: 'Then I'll take her, and afterwards she won't mind, and neither will you.' He sits back down. 'Give it two minutes. The market gets busy. It's the best part.'
shots.light: hard sun
shots.sound: the market ambience FADES BACK UP as he says it

shots.angle: eye, handheld — the first movement in 90 seconds
shots.action: SMASH CUT: Arjun wakes in the bottom of a boat, grey rain, and vomits over the side
shots.light: grey monsoon — the colour drains out of the film in one frame
shots.sound: rain at full volume, brutal after the silence

scenes.title: THE KITE-FIELD (PLOT POINT II)
scenes.objective: Kira wants eleven minutes of being seventeen; Sera wants the girl.

shots.action: THE RAIN STOPS. Low golden light floods forty rooftops; sixty kites go up; laundry snaps; pigeons burst off the coops
shots.light: low golden backlight through rain-haze — the only warm exterior in Acts I-II
shots.vfx: kite crowd sim; haze volumetrics; pigeon sim
shots.sound: the score's only unambiguously joyful cue; kids shouting

shots.action: Kira on the red water-tank flying the saffron kite one-handed and pulling a gold tether with the other — WEAVING the two. First time she uses her power for fun
shots.light: golden backlight rimming her braids and the gold tether identically
shots.sound: line singing; the tether singing; they harmonise

shots.action: The notebook, open on his knee: 'Kira — I need to tell you' / two crossed-out attempts beneath it
shots.light: golden

shots.action: 'You have two faces. Don't. Have the afternoon. It's eleven minutes.' He closes the notebook
shots.light: golden, warm bounce off wet corrugated steel

shots.action: 'She used to make the whole Corps drink water. Went round with a jug like we were children. She had a red thread on her wrist.'
shots.light: golden key, deep warm shadow
shots.sound: the score's Amara motif, first appearance

shots.action: Kira's hands go still on the line. 'I remember the thread.'
shots.light: golden

shots.action: THE GOLDEN LIGHT GOES OUT. Nine Hollow come up over all four roof edges. Walking. Sera Vance, dry in the haze, cracked left gauntlet
shots.light: a cloud takes the sun on cue; the roof goes flat grey in two seconds
shots.vfx: CG cloud shadow pass; mirror plates

shots.action: Arjun anchors and throws a wall — Sera WALKS THROUGH ITS REFLECTION, mirror-plates flaring, and the wall's own energy hammers him across the roof into the pigeon coops
shots.light: cyan flash, silver inversion, feathers everywhere
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — reflection inversion; pigeon sim; coop destruction
shots.sound: chime, reversed chime, an explosion of wings

shots.action: Kira fires six tethers; Sera copy-steps — three afterimages — three tethers bind nothing at all; the real Sera arrives inside her guard
shots.light: gold tethers, grey roof
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — copy-step: three semi-transparent silver afterimages with a 6-frame delay, each landing one strike
shots.sound: three overlapping footfalls where there should be one

shots.action: Two fingers on the girl's throat. 'It doesn't hurt. Doesn't hurt.'
shots.light: flat grey

shots.action: Arjun anchors: a hardlight FLOOR crystallises across the whole roof to trap her feet. Sera simply steps up onto the parapet
shots.light: cyan from the floor lighting everyone from below
shots.vfx: floor tessellation across 30x20m of corrugated roof
shots.sound: the chime, and then the anticlimax of it not working

shots.action: Nine seconds: Kira on the sled, fighting, screaming; she gets ONE tether onto the red water-tank and holds — four seconds — the tank groaning, her palms burning
shots.light: grey; gold tether the only colour
shots.vfx: tether under extreme load with visible strain flicker; water tank deformation
shots.sound: steel groan; her scream; the tether's tone rising toward breaking

shots.action: Her eyes find his across the roof. 'ARJUN—' The tether SNAPS. Her palms open up
shots.light: grey
shots.sound: the snap is the loudest single sound in Act II

shots.action: THE FILM'S CRUELLEST IMAGE: Arjun throws a bastion after the departing sled — a perfect, useless wall of cyan light hanging over empty air, forty metres behind them. It cannot move. He holds it anyway until his nose bleeds and the light goes amber-orange and dies
shots.light: cyan → amber-orange → grey
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — a beautifully rendered, completely pointless hardlight wall in empty sky
shots.sound: the chime sustaining, then souring, then decaying to nothing

shots.action: The golden light comes back for its last four minutes. The kites keep flying. It is obscene
shots.light: golden
shots.sound: the joyful cue returns in a minor key

scenes.title: SIXTEEN TIMES (ALL IS LOST)
scenes.slug: EXT./INT. UNDER THE STILTWAY — BHASKAR'S BOAT
scenes.objective: Arjun wants to remember what just happened long enough to act on it.

shots.action: Rain drumming on tarpaulin. A single bulb swinging. Arjun on the boat's floor, back against the hull, notebook open in both hands, reading his own handwriting like a foreign language
shots.light: one swinging 40W bulb — the light source physically moves, so the shadows do too
shots.sound: DIRECT SOUND DROPS OUT: heartbeat and a high thin tone only

shots.action: His face. The film's ONLY digital-artefact language: micro-stutters, a dropped frame at a name, a four-frame repeat
shots.light: swinging bulb
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — deliberate frame-level corruption: 1-frame drops, 4-frame repeats, no glitch clichés, no RGB split
shots.sound: the tone; a stutter in the room tone matching the picture

shots.action: Riya comes down the ladder soaked and sees his face. 'Arjun. Hey. Hey.'
shots.light: bulb, rain-light from the hatch
shots.sound: direct sound snaps back on with her voice

shots.action: He looks up, polite and pleasant and absolutely blank: 'I'm sorry — are you the doctor?'
shots.light: bulb

shots.action: Riya stops breathing. Then, carefully: 'It's Riya.'
shots.light: bulb, half her face out

shots.action: His finger on the page: 'Riya Sen. You loved her. She left in the rain. It was fair.'
shots.light: bulb only

shots.action: 'I have the sentence, I don't have the woman.' Then, pages faster, fear entering: 'There's a name in here three times and I can't see her face.'
shots.light: bulb

shots.angle: eye, both on the wet floor
shots.action: He puts the notebook down carefully, like it's full of water. 'Who did I lose today?' She sits beside him, not touching him, and tells him
shots.light: bulb, both of them low in frame with a lot of dark hull above — the most crushed composition in the film

shots.angle: high, looking down into the boat
shots.action: 'Say it again in a minute. It sticks if you say it enough.' TIME-LAPSE DISSOLVE: she says it sixteen times through the night while he writes it down; the bulb burns; rain continues
shots.light: the bulb dims and brightens with the boat's generator across the night
shots.vfx: dissolve chain; notebook page filling with the same name
shots.sound: her voice repeating, layered, sixteen takes overlapping into a lullaby

scenes.title: THE ANCHOR PROCEDURE
scenes.objective: Meera gives Arjun the only weapon that works, knowing what it costs.

shots.action: The clinic is a black shell. Rain falls through the burnt roof into the dead aquarium. Ten thousand index cards are a grey smear underfoot. Meera stands in it holding the warped class photograph
shots.light: one work-lamp on a cable; rain-light from the hole in the roof; everything else charcoal
shots.sound: rain into standing water; dripping; wind through a burnt wall

shots.action: Her shoe toeing the ash — and under it, one unburnt index card with a name still legible
shots.light: work-lamp raking across the ash texture

shots.action: 'Eleven thousand four hundred people's memories. He'd say look how much of you is a filing cabinet for pain. The horrible thing is that most days I don't have an argument.'
shots.light: work-lamp, hard, from below-left

shots.action: The copper stabiliser disc set on the burnt bench; her brass fingers turning it over to show the reversible polarity face
shots.light: work-lamp, specular on copper

shots.action: THE PLAN: 'You become a ground. Every joule the Loom pushes into eight million people, you take through yourself, and you put it in the mud.'
shots.light: one lamp between three faces; the rest of the frame black

shots.action: THE PRICE: 'Not the last month. All of it. Ila. The Corps. Me. Her. You would not know your own name until someone told you, and then you'd know it the way you know a fact.'
shots.light: lamp; her glasses catch and hide her eyes for two seconds, then she moves and we get them back

shots.action: 'Okay.' Immediate. No hesitation at all
shots.light: lamp

shots.action: 'That's not a sacrifice. That's a bargain.' / Meera breaks after 61 years of holding: 'Every single thing that is about to happen came out of my hands.'
shots.light: lamp

shots.action: He takes her BRASS HAND in both of his — the only real embrace in the film. 'Then build me one more thing.'
shots.light: lamp; the brass and the human hands lit identically
shots.vfx: prosthetic detail; a faint amber pulse in the filament channels
shots.sound: the prosthetic's small servo, and the score entering under it
